name: University of North Texas
description: The University of North Texas is a public research university in Denton, Texas, north of Dallas, founded in 1890. It is one of the largest universities in Texas, with colleges of engineering, business, information and music.
whyIncluded: One of the 10 universities in the US most popular with international students; the US is one of the nine places Singaporeans most often study abroad (about 3,800 Singaporean students, UNESCO data).

livingCosts.summary: UNT's official 2026-27 living-expenses estimate for international undergraduates in Denton (US$18,955 for the 9-month academic year), split into rent, food, transport and personal using typical US shares. Books and health insurance are a separate line and are excluded.
livingCosts.notes: Rung B. UNT International Affairs 'Undergraduate Estimated Cost of Attendance for 2026-27' (same figures in the 2026-27 I-20 expense worksheet PDF): 'Academic Year -- 9 months', 12 credits per semester; Living Expenses 18,955 for every college, Other (Books, Insurance) 3,926, tuition/fees by college (e.g. Engineering 22,521). Living Expenses is a single figure with no breakdown, so monthly = 18,955 / 9 = 2,106.11 split with the US average shares .63/.20/.02/.15: housing 1,326.85, food 421.22, transport 42.12, personal 315.92. The 'Other' line (3,926) combines books with mandatory health insurance and cannot be separated, so it is excluded; tuition/fees and the optional 3-month summer (living 6,824) excluded. The general financialaid.unt.edu COA pages list categories without amounts.

programmes.name: BS in Mechanical and Energy Engineering (College of Engineering)
programmes.feeBasis: UNT's 2026-27 non-resident per-credit tuition plus the Engineering surcharge (US$16.25 a credit) times 30 credits (15 a semester), plus per-credit and per-semester fees.
programmes.summary: Yearly non-resident tuition at 15 credits a semester plus UNT's mandatory fees. International students pay the out-of-state rate. Course fees and health insurance not included.
programmes.notes: UNT Student Accounting 'Tuition and Fees', Fall 2026-Summer 2027, non-resident (international students pay the non-resident rate): statutory tuition US$478/credit + Board Designated Tuition (Traditional Plan) US$230.11/credit + Engineering differential US$16.25/credit. Annual = 15 credits a semester x 2 = 30 credits: US$21,730.80. Compulsory fees (15 credits a semester, explanation-fees page, Fall 2026-Spring 2027; same rates in the 2025-2026 manual): Student Service US$13.41/hr, Intercollegiate Athletics US$17.85/hr (capped at 15 hrs), Transportation US$3.50/hr, Learning Support US$43/hr, Recreational Facility US$85.78, Environmental Services US$5, Student Union US$167, Medical Services US$66.85, International Education US$4, International Student Fee US$115 (non-immigrant visa students) per semester; x 2 = US$3,220.06 a year. Course-specific instructional fees (vary by course) and health insurance are excluded. 2025-26 row: non-resident statutory tuition US$455/credit with the same designated, differential and fee rates (UNT Tuition & Fees Administrative Manual 2025-2026) = US$21,040.80 tuition. UNT's own I-20 estimate assumes 12 credits a semester (minimum full-time), so it is lower. UNT also offers a fixed-rate 'Save and Soar' plan (US$234.71/credit designated tuition); the Traditional Plan is used here. Not cohort-locked. 2024-25 row: UNT Tuition & Fees Administrative Manual 2024-2025 (read 2026-10-13): non-resident statutory tuition US$460/credit, with the same designated, board, differential and per-hour/per-semester fee rates as above; 30 credits = US$21,190.80 tuition.
